messages:
Mia: Quick heads-up Aurora Spark NDA signed today. Want to lock EAP bench matrix and telemetry whitelist.
Andrew: Nice. Partner asked that we prioritize int4 perf on conversational workloads and cold-start latencies.
Aurora-poc: We'll ship 3 dev modules next Tue and upload driver image `aurora-spark-rt.img` + ref container `aurora/ref:2026-06` to our portal. Portal URL will be shared in DM for creds.
Legal-bot: NDA status: countersigned. Forbidden: microcode dumps, JTAG traces, raw kernel oops. Allowed: perf counters, memory usage, limited dmesg. Partner requires partner-copy scrubbed.
Sara: Proposed bench plan: 1) cold-start chat (prompt+sampling) 2) steady-throughput sweep 3) int4 quant accuracy vs int8. Capture power, PCIe counters, and temp.
Ops-Joel: Need exact commands and desired image SHA to template infra job and request egress exception for portal. Also ask partner for a smoke test script so we can validate image.
Andrew: Example commands to include in infra job:
```
./benchctl --model rwd-chat-7b --mode cold --seq 256 --batch 1 --out s3://bench/aurora/1867890123/cold
./benchctl --model rwd-chat-7b --mode throughput --seq 1024 --batch 32 --out s3://bench/aurora/1867890123/throughput
./benchctl --model rwd-chat-7b --mode quant --quant int4,int8 --out s3://bench/aurora/1867890123/quant
```
Mia: Important: add `--strip-firmware` and `--anonymize` before uploading partner artifacts. Legal will review scrubbed partner copy.
Aurora-poc: We'll provide power helper script and a smoke test. Shipping ETA Mon 2026-06-15. We'll share one-time download token via vault.
Bench-bot: Run queued on infra-gpu-12. Est runtime 3.5h. Artifacts will be posted to s3://bench/aurora/1867890123/meta.json when done.
Bench-bot: Latency pass complete. Summary: cold p50=38ms p99=190ms; throughput=1780 tok/s (fp16). Int4 quant run queued. Full artifacts -> s3://bench/aurora/1867890123/results.tar.gz
Sara: Good progress. Action items: (1) Aurora upload driver/container and smoke test (aurora-poc) (2) Ops bake golden image and egress (ops-joel) (3) Run int4 and produce internal + scrubbed partner report (andrew/sara) (4) Legal sign-off on partner copy (legal-bot).
Mia: Also note marketing asked to hold any joint announcement until partner approves numbers and legal okays copy. We'll schedule a 30m review after scrubbed results.
Andrew: Will stash raw CSVs and generate partner-copy scrubbed JSON by EOD after int4.
Mia: Thanks all. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
